productDetails.name: Mangosteen · Juice 30% · 330 ml
productDetails.headline: Mangosteen
productDetails.subtitle: Tropical. Delicate. Refreshingly different.
productDetails.introduction:
Beneath its deep purple rind, mangosteen reveals soft, ivory segments with a delicately sweet, gently tangy taste. Often called the queen of tropical fruits, it brings a distinctive character to the Vinut fruit collection.

Discover that tropical flavor in a convenient 330 ml can, made with 30% mangosteen juice. Serve chilled and enjoy a refreshing pause, wherever the day takes you.
productDetails.ingredients: Water, mangosteen juice 30%, sugar, citric acid, mangosteen flavour, ascorbic acid, sweeteners (E951, E955), colours (E102).
productDetails.companyName: NAM VIET FOODS AND BEVERAGE JSC
productDetails.companyAddress: 994/1C Nguyen Thi Minh Khai Street, Tan Thang Quarter, Tan Binh Ward, Di An City, Binh Duong Province, Vietnam
productDetails.storage: Store in a dry and cool place. Shake well. Best served chilled.
productDetails.shelfLife: Use by date on the bottom of the can. Do not drink after the expiration date.
